name: Du Qinglian
source:
An innocent man who has an expert medical skill.
No one knows why he went into seclusion despite his birth of good ancestry.
"Don't you believe in me? Or you just don't believe in yourself?"
"I won't regret what I said."
(Translated from Weibo)
